name: Calculate
description: Free private calculators for marketplace payouts, tickets, mortgages, health, DIY, and unit conversion. All math runs in the browser.

tools.name: Marketplace payout calculator
tools.description: Compare estimated take-home selling the same item on eBay, Poshmark, Whatnot, Fashionphile, The RealReal, Mercari, Depop, and Etsy.

tools.name: StubHub and Ticketmaster resale calculator
tools.description: Compare seller net on StubHub, Ticketmaster Resale, and SeatGeek, or back into the list price to hit a target net.

tools.name: Mortgage calculator
tools.description: Monthly principal and interest, taxes, insurance, HOA, PMI, extra principal, and an amortization snapshot.

tools.name: Refinance calculator
tools.description: Compare current vs new loan payment, closing costs, and break-even months.

tools.name: Loan amortization calculator
tools.description: Fixed-rate installment payment, extra principal, total interest, and payoff date.

tools.name: Compound interest calculator
tools.description: Future value with compounding frequency and recurring contributions.

tools.name: Tip calculator
tools.description: Tip amount, total, and even split on the full bill or pre-tax amount.

tools.name: BMI calculator
tools.description: US and metric BMI, WHO category, and a healthy-weight range. Screening only.

tools.name: Body-fat estimate
tools.description: U.S. Navy circumference body-fat estimate. Not a clinical measurement.

tools.name: TDEE calculator
tools.description: Mifflin–St Jeor BMR, activity multiplier, cut and gain calorie targets.

tools.name: Paint coverage calculator
tools.description: Gallons of paint from room dimensions or square footage, including coats.

tools.name: Flooring estimator
tools.description: Flooring square footage with waste, box count, and material cost.

tools.name: Concrete volume calculator
tools.description: Slab volume in cubic yards plus 40/60/80 lb bag estimates.

tools.name: Tile estimator
tools.description: Tile count from room size, grout gap, waste, and boxes.

tools.name: Length converter
tools.description: Convert metric and imperial length units using exact SI factors.

tools.name: Weight converter
tools.description: Convert mass units including kilograms, pounds, ounces, and stone.

tools.name: Volume converter
tools.description: Convert liters, US kitchen measures, UK gallons, and cubic units.

tools.name: Temperature converter
tools.description: Convert Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, and Rankine.

tools.name: Area converter
tools.description: Convert square meters, feet, acres, hectares, and square miles.

tools.name: Percentage calculator
tools.description: What is X% of Y, reverse percent, percent change, increase or decrease.
